summary: Centrus Energy filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026, disclosing a definitive multi-year contract with Antares Nuclear to supply high-assay low-enriched uranium (HALEU), with deliveries beginning before the end of the current decade. The contract adds a HALEU customer to Centrus' backlog and includes prepayments from Antares to advance domestic enrichment capacity buildout. No stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, or financial advisor was disclosed. This is an ordinary commercial supply agreement, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
